scope_label: Kingdom of the Netherlands and Dutch royal-house award systems

sources.source_name: World Medals Index - Orders, Decorations and Medals of the Kingdom of the Netherlands Text List
sources.scope_dates: Dutch Republic and Kingdom periods represented by the listed award pages; detail coverage begins in 1813 and extends to contemporary awards
sources.coverage_result: Text List exposed 34 linked award detail pages; 34/34 pages returned HTTP 200 and their image captions/date fields were parsed. 33 distinct complete-front image candidates were found. First batch selected 21 front variants across 12 families; 12 other front images and all unpictured names remain for later formal-scope and variant review.
sources.rights_status: Individual object pages do not state photographer or redistribution terms; local research use only pending rights review.

sources.source_name: Orders, decorations, and medals of the Netherlands (English Wikipedia inventory)
sources.coverage_result: Full overview opened. It distinguishes chivalric orders, house orders, state bravery/merit/operation awards, commemoratives, service awards, private organizations, and international awards. Used only as a scope/discovery crosswalk; candidate-by-candidate historical and image sweep remains.
sources.rights_status: Discovery source only; image thumbnails/ribbons not harvested.

sources.source_name: Royal House of the Netherlands - Personal decorations
sources.coverage_result: Official overview confirms two civilian orders, the Military Order of William as the sole military order, key foundation date/class distinctions for the three chivalric orders, and separates royal-house awards. It is not a complete inventory of all Dutch state medals.

sources.source_name: Royal Honours and Decorations - Military Order of William
sources.coverage_result: Official page confirms foundation on 30 April 1815 and four classes; used to cross-check the WMI class names and date.

sources.source_name: Netherlands official Decision on the Order of Wear of Decorations
sources.coverage_result: Official source found in search; web reader returned an internal error when opened, so the annex and current award list were not extracted. Revisit via the official gazette/dataset interface.

sources.coverage_result: Discovered from the Wikipedia inventory Commons link; no category or file pages scanned in this batch.
